bio_en: Petros Hakobian was born in Kharpert in September 1868 and moved as a child to Mush, where he graduated from the Mush central school in 1884 and became a teacher at Mokunk. Arrested in Izmir while preparing to leave for America, he was freed in Constantinople in 1888 through his father's friends, and taught at Yalova, Kurdz and Bardizag. He reached America in 1891, living in Boston and Lynn, and settled in California in 1901. He died in Fresno on 12 July 1931 aged 63, a respected member of the local ARF committee.
